title: Bengaluru court grants bail to Prakash Raj in multiple voter ID case
description: A Bengaluru court on July 10 granted bail to actor and former independent Lok Sabha candidate Prakash Raj in a case alleging that he was enrolled as a voter in multiple Assembly constituencies across different States and concealed those details in an affidavit filed along with his nomination papers for the 2019 Lok Sabha elections.Chief Judicial Magistrate Jyoti Shantappa Kale granted bail to Prakash Raj on the condition that he furnish a cash security of ₹4,000 and appear before the court on ev
